_comment: Effects that exist in a mod but whose behaviour couldn't be verified yet. They are not shown on the site. Move a draft to effects.json (with an id, all fields and the writing rules applied) once its description is known.

drafts.description: Explodes at the end of the effect (explosion power level, destroys blocks if mob griefing is enabled).
drafts.notes: No lang entry in the jar. PotionFireFuse: explode(radius=amp+1) when duration<=3 ticks; mode TNT if mobGriefing. Applied for 5 s by Serenade of the Nether with Vengeful Will.

drafts.description: Every 0.5 seconds grows plants around the mob and deals 0.5 × 3/(level + 2) damage per grown plant.
drafts.notes: No lang entry in the jar. BMPotionUtils.damageMobAndGrowSurroundingPlants(entity, 2+amp, 1, 0.5*3/(amp+3), 25*(1+amp)). Applied 10 s. Description formula unchecked against the wording rules.

drafts.description: Makes the animal attack nearby monsters and explode (power 2) when it reaches its target.
drafts.notes: No lang entry in the jar. Explosion power 2+1.5*amp, no block damage; applied 60 s.

drafts.description: Monsters that die with the effect drop a Monster Soul (demon will).
drafts.notes: No lang entry in the jar. WillHandler: on drops, will = random*(amp+1)^2*4+1; applies to Mobs or any entity on Peaceful. Applied for 15 s by the thrown Soul Snare.

drafts.description: Disables the entity's shield for 5 seconds.
drafts.source: Dark Warblade hits on shield mobs, Detonation, Dark Splash, various mob attacks
drafts.notes: Hidden effect (client extension isVisibleInGui/Inventory false). onEffectStarted: puts shield in offhand (or main hand) on a 100 tick cooldown for players. Applied for 60-500 ticks by many mob attack procedures.

drafts.description: Marks the entity as cursed; no gameplay effect of its own was found.
drafts.notes: Class has no logic and no code in the mod reads hasEffect(CURSED_MARK) except being applied (Fallen Chaos Knight attack on players not blocking, 3400 ticks; Spiritual Easter Egg hit 100 ticks). Possibly used by datapack/other mods. Left in drafts.

drafts.description: After about 1 second hits entities within 4.5 blocks for 9 damage and Stun for 2 seconds.
drafts.notes: Hidden in GUI. Counter 'stunningstrike' 20 ticks then AoE (inflate 4.5): hurt(GENERIC, 9) and Stun 40 ticks, adds Block Break 500 ticks to the user, removes itself. Mob-only mechanic (Missionary).

drafts.description: Turns into a random effect combination for 5 seconds (e.g. Absorption, Regeneration, Stimulation, Rampage, Fire Resistance, Vampiric Touch with Bone Barrier, or Nausea with Hunger).
drafts.notes: Hidden in GUI. Eternal Candy applies it for 10 ticks; SweetMadnessKazhdyiTik picks via persistent data flags (random Math.random roll in SweetMadnessPriNalozhenii) one of: protection (Absorption, Resistance, Wither Resistance 100 ticks), treatment (Regeneration + 2 health), energy (Stimulation II), power (Light Rampage), hot (Fire Resistance + Insect Protection), creepy (Vampiric Touch + Bone Barrier), bad (Nausea + Hunger) and removes itself.

drafts.description: Reduces attack damage by 40%, grants Resistance III, regenerates and damages entities within 7 blocks with wither damage.
drafts.notes: Hidden in GUI, mob-only (Nightmare Stalker boss phase, 2000 ticks, no Wither Resistance entities damaged: 2-4 damage by world dayTime). Not read fully.

drafts.source: Nightmare Mask helmet (in light level 4 or lower)
drafts.notes: Hidden in GUI. MOVEMENT_SPEED +0.22 ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE per level. NightmareMantleoftheNightKazhdyiTikDliaShliema (helmet armor tick): if light <= 4 gives Unity With Darkness amp 1 (level II) for 20 ticks, no icon. Also used by Nightmare Stalker mob.

Decompiled dungeons_and_combat-1.2.2-forge-1.20.1.jar (MCreator mod, closed source, no public repo). Hood Of Shame helmet tick applies it (60 ticks, hidden) but no code anywhere checks for it (no hasEffect, no attribute modifier, no mixin found). Existing description 'increases the range from which mobs detect the player' could not be confirmed. Category NEUTRAL.

drafts.description: Increases Soul Shard drops from Reaper Scythe and ritual kills and gives 25% more experience from kills.
drafts.source: Red Candy, Grape Candy, Soul Harvest Incense
drafts.notes: Registered (SHarvestEffect) but has no lang entry in 1.20/1.21 so the jar scan did not list it (raw key shown in game). Events: +2 looting for soul shard drop, xp x1.25. Promote if a name is acceptable. registryId is eidolon_repraised:soul_harvest in 1.21.

1.20 jar registers FogSightEffect (plain MobEffect, BENEFICIAL, no logic) and no code references it; the brewing recipe is commented out in JNEPotionRecipe. Appears unfinished/unused. Removed in 1.21.

Registered as a bare FastFalling effect (no attribute, no tick logic) and nothing in the code checks hasEffect(FEAR); SkeletosaurusEntity applies it in an arc for a duration variable. Seems to be purely cosmetic/unused.

drafts.description: Possessed mobs lose their AI. The possessing player cannot move or attack and controls the mob (Level III: permanent, player is invisible at the mob).
drafts.notes: Not fully verified: EffectPossession disables mob AI (level I on the target), caster gets level II (possession) or III (greater possession) which disables movement and attacks; the control mechanism itself lives in client/network code not read. Undead faction spell.

drafts.description: Gives the player knockback resistance and reduces damage taken by 50%.
drafts.notes: Registered in EffectRegistry (attribute knockback resistance +1) and applied by SoulPyreAbilityManager (duration of the pyre + 2 ticks), LivingEntityMixin multiplies damage by 0.5, matching the Soul Pyre tooltip. But there is no effect.simplyswords.soul_tether lang entry in en_us.json (it was not in the jar scan), so the in-game name is the raw key; I could not take an English name from the lang file.
